newCharacters.name: Hero
newCharacters.description: Young man with spiky black hair and a torn red scarf

newCharacters.name: Mentor
newCharacters.description: Elderly man with a white beard and a wooden staff

cues.text: The mountain village slept under a pale moon.
Steady. Do not draw your sword yet.
I won't let them take this place.

recap.text: Mumu remembers: a quiet village, a nervous hero, and a mentor who sensed trouble before anyone else.
